notes.title: EDFWB2 Extra Mission Pack AVAILABLE NOW!!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=0u-cJBI15Mg;full][/previewyoutube]
A collection of additional missions featuring many new enemies that did not appear in the main game.

Included in this collection is another story that took place in the time line corresponding to missions 79 to 83 of the main game. It depicts the anguish and conflict of a certain separate unit and the end of a secret EDF weapon that was never deployed in actual combat in the main game.

More than 10 high level missions for the elite members are included in the game. The game is recommended only for those who have completed the main game and are confident in their skills.

notes.title: “CUSTOM MECH WARS” Coming THIS WINTER!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564496/12c4f184c1de63c5038d2dfd4a9ce55d2946dacd.jpg[/img]
Creativity fuels conflict...
A mecha action shooter with Omega Customization options [b]“CUSTOM MECH WARS”[/b] Coming THIS WINTER!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564496/c60652a70447c24ed29c30fcb41cce27790a681c.jpg[/img]

Take customization to the extreme with [b]the Omega Customization System[/b] and battle with one-of-a-kind combat units in this all-new third-person shooter mecha game.

Freely build mechs with all kinds of designs and parameters, no matter how unconventional—the only limit is your imagination. Take, for instance, the Full Weapon Bot, armed to the teeth with ten rifles and ten missiles; the Asuro Bot, equipped for battle with three heads and six arms; the Motor Bot, mounted with several bazookas; and the Bipedal Tank, a combat vehicle with legs.

Deploy your custom mechs and battle against fleets of oncoming enemies. Collect parts from the destroyed enemies for further customization. Then, take your highly personalized mechs on ever more challenging missions.

The battlefield extends online, where you can join forces with other players to complete co-op missions. Awe your friends with your endlessly imaginative customizations.

Your creativity will throw fuel on the fire of this mecha-based conflict. The grand battle of Omega Customized mecha starts here!

notes.title: Game Update Patch Notes-Ver1.01-October 29, 2019
notes.notes:
Game Update Patch Notes-Ver1.01-October 29, 2019

1. Mouse Sensitivity Adjusted
Mouse sensitivity for when aiming has been adjusted. 
The main change is that aim speed will no longer accelerate as 
a result of the character rotating.

2. Fixed Issue with 3D Resolution
We have fixed the issue which caused the game screen to upscale 
and always display at 75% of the chosen resolution. 
Note that in some environments, this may cause a reduction in framerate.

3. Fixed E-Needle Issue
We have fixed the issue of the Prowl Rider’s E-Needle energy move 
sometimes not clinging to a wall surface when in contact with a collision (wall, etc).

4. Fixed Language Setting Issue
We have fixed the issue of the Tutorial displaying in Japanese regardless of the 
user’s current Steam language setting. After this fix, if you still experience issues 
with the wrong language displaying, please reselect your language setting 
at the game’s title screen.

5. Fixed Issue with Moving Using the Keyboard
We have fixed the issue occurring when using the keyboard to move (walk) or sprint, 
in which a character would stop moving when too many keys were pressed at once.
 Specifically, when pressing the key to walk backward (S) simultaneously with 
the key to walk forward (W), and then releasing the key to walk backward, 
the character would stop moving, despite the walk forward key still being 
pressed; this issue has been fixed.

notes.title: Earth Defense Force: Iron Rain is now smashing bugs on PC
notes.notes:
Grab the bug spray, we’ve got another infestation on our hands. A mere 3 months since the last insect invasion hit our shores, Earth Defense Force: Iron Rain invades Steam today. It’s another one of those, absolutely, with plenty of opportunities to turn thousands of insects, robots and monsters into juicy yellow smears on the side of a mountain. But this time around, EDF wants to be taken a little bit more seriously, painting a more contemporary picture of an extraterrestrial invasion – for better and for worse.
